total_tasks.description: Total number of tasks registered in the task registry

completed.description: Number of tasks with status DONE (fully completed, approved, and closed)

failed.description: Number of tasks that have failed and are not recoverable

in_progress.description: Number of tasks currently in ASSIGNED or IN_PROGRESS status

ready.description: Number of tasks in READY status awaiting assignment

average_validation_attempts.description: Average number of validation cycles per completed task

average_repair_attempts.description: Average number of repair cycles per completed task

security_score.description: Security posture score (0-100). Calculated from completed security tasks / total security tasks. Starting low as most security tasks are still pending.

performance_score.description: Performance optimization score (0-100). Based on completion of performance-related tasks.

frontend_score.description: Frontend stability and quality score (0-100). Based on frontend-specific task completions.

backend_score.description: Backend architecture and quality score (0-100). Based on backend-specific task completions and maturity score from EXECUTION_PLAN.json.

deployment_readiness.description: Overall deployment readiness score (0-100). 56% of tasks are production_blocker=true and must be completed before deployment.

technical_debt_score.description: Estimated technical debt score (0-100, higher = more debt). Based on 41 ruff lint errors, 10+ TypeScript errors, pre-existing pymongo/motor incompatibility, and missing test coverage.

velocity.description: Tasks completed per day (running average). Currently 1 task completed (SEC-002) over approximately 4 days of project activity.

lead_time.description: Average time from task creation to completion in days for completed tasks.

cycle_time.description: Average time from task start to completion in days for completed tasks.

estimated_hours_remaining.description: Total estimated hours for all non-completed tasks

completed_hours.description: Total estimated hours for completed tasks
